@traced_operation("cache_review")
async def review_snapshot(owner, snapshot, *, navigation=False, full=True, plan=None, allow_partial=True, pixel_only=False, allow_stale=False):
    """The live admission policy shared by cache, direct and follow-up reads.

    Selection is separate from review. Pixels challenge dependencies; only a
    confirmed page/lifecycle transition revokes the underlying candidate.
    """
    import asyncio

    from .fact_lifecycle import observation_tick
    from .live_refresh import (
        compare_live_frames,
        fetch_recent_frame,
        frame_stamp,
        invalidate_frame_change,
        trace_refresh,
    )

    if not snapshot or getattr(owner, "_observation_invalidated", False):
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="candidate_missing" if not snapshot else "observation_invalidated")
        return None
    pending_reason = getattr(owner, "_observation_pending_reason", "")
    recovering = pending_reason.startswith(("capture_unavailable", "capture_error"))
    if (not owner._observer_status.get("enabled") or getattr(owner, "_observer_stop_requested", False)
            or owner._observer_status.get("state") not in {"observing", "updating"} and not (
            recovering and owner._observer_status.get("state") in {"error", "updating"})):
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="observer_not_observing")
        return None
    evidence = snapshot["evidence"]
    guard = snapshot["guard"]
    if plan is not None:
        from .delivery_scope import select_scoped_guard
        selected = select_scoped_guard(owner, evidence, plan, [guard], proof_source=snapshot, allow_partial=allow_partial)
        if selected is None:
            trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="missing_proof")
            return None
        evidence, guard = selected
    epoch = getattr(owner, "_observation_epoch", 0)
    serial = getattr(owner, "_observation_serial", 0)
    owns_current = (not snapshot.get("detached_region")
                    and (snapshot["evidence"].get("screen_facts") or {}).get("observation_serial", serial) == serial)
    generation = getattr(owner, "_answer_query_generation", 0)

    def still_current():
        return (epoch, serial, generation) == (getattr(owner, "_observation_epoch", 0),
            getattr(owner, "_observation_serial", 0), getattr(owner, "_answer_query_generation", 0))
    try:
        age = observation_tick(time.time()) - datetime.fromisoformat(evidence["observed_at"]).timestamp()
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        return None
    age_policy = stale_state(evidence.get("page_type"), age, allow_stale=allow_stale)
    if age_policy == "invalid" or snapshot["epoch"] != epoch:
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="candidate_epoch_mismatch" if snapshot["epoch"] != epoch else "invalid_timestamp")
        return None
    if age_policy == "expired":
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="stale_expired", age_seconds=round(age, 1))
        return None
    if age_policy == "not_allowed":
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="stale_not_allowed", age_seconds=round(age, 1))
        return None
    client = getattr(owner, "_assistant_client", None)
    if client is None or not snapshot["game_pid"]:
        return None
    # A single old transfer is not proof the game is unavailable. Retry the
    # capture sequence within the SAME caller deadline, not the whole OCR.
    latest = await fetch_recent_frame(owner)
    if not still_current():
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_superseded", serial=serial,
                      current_serial=getattr(owner, "_observation_serial", 0))
        return _SUPERSEDED
    if (latest is None or not 0 <= time.time() - latest.timestamp <= LIVE_FRAME_MAX_AGE_SECONDS
            or latest.game.get("pid") != snapshot["game_pid"] or latest.game.get("minimized")
            or not latest.game.get("running") or latest.capture.get("state") != "capturing"
            or latest.capture.get("isolated_window") is not True):
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="capture_unavailable")
        await owner._invalidate_current_observation("capture_unavailable_for_reuse")
        return None
    regions, patches = guard
    try:
        current_stamp = await asyncio.to_thread(frame_stamp, latest.image_bytes)
        current_patches = await asyncio.to_thread(region_stamp, latest.image_bytes, regions)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        if not still_current():
            return _SUPERSEDED
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="invalid_image")
        await owner._invalidate_current_observation("capture_unavailable_for_reuse")
        return None
    if not still_current():
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_superseded", serial=serial,
                      current_serial=getattr(owner, "_observation_serial", 0))
        return _SUPERSEDED
    # Global transitions plus native-resolution text/control checks. This is a
    # conservative heuristic, not proof that arbitrary unseen pixels are equal.
    # Exploration's 3D camera is not a page transition. Its text/control
    # regions still determine whether this particular snapshot can be reused.
    # A complete native guard already includes independent page controls.
    # Coarse animated pixels are not a second, overriding page detector.
    global_changed = compare_live_frames(owner, snapshot["stamp"], current_stamp, ui_only=bool(regions))
    text_changed = regions_changed(patches, current_patches)
    native_reviewed = False
    if pixel_only and (global_changed or text_changed):
        trace_refresh(owner, "native_review_deferred", reason="page_first", region_count=len(regions))
        return None  # Not a proof, not a revocation, and never an OCR queue job.
    if text_changed and not global_changed and len(patches) == len(current_patches):
        from .live_refresh import revalidate_guard_text

        if (getattr(owner, "_vision_schedule_role", "idle") == "producer"
                and not callable(getattr(getattr(owner, "_vision", None), "enqueue_review", None))):
            # This cache needs native OCR, but the resident producer already
            # owns recognition and its final validation. Join that producer
            # through refresh_for_query rather than spending the entire query
            # deadline queued with a frame that will be stale on admission.
            # Pixel-only cache hits above remain usable during recognition.
            trace_refresh(owner, "delivery_deferred", reason="busy")
            return None
        coordinates = {before[0] for before, after in zip(patches, current_patches)
                       if regions_changed((before,), (after,))}
        same_text = await revalidate_guard_text(owner, latest, coordinates, evidence=evidence, controls=regions,
                                               reference_guard=guard)
        native_reviewed = True
        if not still_current():
            trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_superseded", serial=serial,
                          current_serial=getattr(owner, "_observation_serial", 0))
            return _SUPERSEDED
        if same_text.capture is not None:
            # The producer admitted the queued review on a NEW capture. Bind
            # data/patches to that capture, never its stale pre-queue pixels.
            latest = same_text.capture
            current_patches = await asyncio.to_thread(region_stamp, latest.image_bytes, regions)
            current_stamp = await asyncio.to_thread(frame_stamp, latest.image_bytes)
            if not still_current() or len(current_patches) != len(patches):
                return _SUPERSEDED if not still_current() else None
            coordinates = {a[0] for a, b in zip(patches, current_patches) if regions_changed((a,), (b,))}
            from .live_refresh import TextVerification
            proved = same_text.confirmed_coordinates
            same_text = TextVerification("confirmed" if coordinates <= proved else "unconfirmed", proved)
        if not 0 <= time.time() - latest.timestamp <= LIVE_FRAME_MAX_AGE_SECONDS:
            # OCR can finish after its input's two-second capture window. Do
            # not repeat OCR or relax that window: carry only literal proofs
            # whose native patches still match a genuinely fresh frame.
            from .live_refresh import TextVerification
            newer = await fetch_recent_frame(owner)
            if not still_current():
                return _SUPERSEDED
            if newer is None or newer.game.get("pid") != snapshot["game_pid"]:
                return None
            newer_patches = await asyncio.to_thread(region_stamp, newer.image_bytes, regions)
            if not still_current():
                return _SUPERSEDED
            if (len(newer_patches) != len(current_patches)
                    or not 0 <= time.time() - newer.timestamp <= LIVE_FRAME_MAX_AGE_SECONDS):
                return None
            unchanged = {a[0] for a, b in zip(current_patches, newer_patches) if not regions_changed((a,), (b,))}
            admitted = (coordinates if same_text else same_text.confirmed_coordinates) & unchanged
            coordinates = {a[0] for a, b in zip(patches, newer_patches) if regions_changed((a,), (b,))}
            same_text = TextVerification("confirmed" if coordinates <= admitted else "unconfirmed", frozenset(admitted))
            latest, current_patches = newer, newer_patches
            current_stamp = await asyncio.to_thread(frame_stamp, latest.image_bytes)
            if not still_current():
                return _SUPERSEDED
            trace_refresh(owner, "verification_frame_advanced", region_count=len(admitted))
        if same_text:
            from .delivery_scope import update_checked_patches
            from .observation_store import ObservationStore
            if owns_current:
                ObservationStore(owner).clear_deferred(coordinates)
            update_checked_patches(owner, current_patches, selected_snapshot=snapshot)
            if plan is None:
                snapshot["guard"] = (regions, current_patches)
                snapshot["stamp"] = current_stamp
                owner._accepted_frame_stamp = current_stamp
            delivery = getattr(owner, "_accepted_frame_delivery_guard", None)
            mapped = {patch[0]: patch for patch in current_patches}
            if plan is None and delivery and all(patch[0] in mapped for patch in delivery[1]):
                owner._accepted_frame_delivery_guard = (delivery[0], tuple(mapped[p[0]] for p in delivery[1]))
            text_changed = False
            trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_text_revalidated", serial=serial)
        else:
            if not owns_current and (plan is None or not allow_partial
                    or same_text.state not in {"unconfirmed", "missing_proof"}):
                trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="retained_proof_rejected")
                return None  # Old proofs cannot quarantine or revoke a newer commit.
            if same_text.confirmed_coordinates:
                from .delivery_scope import update_checked_patches
                from .observation_store import ObservationStore
                proved = same_text.confirmed_coordinates
                update_checked_patches(owner, tuple(p for p in current_patches if p[0] in proved), selected_snapshot=snapshot)
                mapped = {p[0]: p for p in current_patches if p[0] in proved}
                guard = (regions, tuple(mapped.get(p[0], p) for p in patches))
                patches = guard[1]
                if owns_current:
                    ObservationStore(owner).clear_deferred(proved)
                coordinates -= proved
            # Failure to prove a literal (including weak OCR) is NOT a new
            # value. Background and query reviewers quarantine the same way;
            # neither destroys fields or the reusable candidate collection.
            from .observation_store import ObservationStore
            if owns_current:
                ObservationStore(owner).defer_regions(coordinates)
            trace_refresh(owner, "delivery_deferred", reason=same_text.state)
            if plan is None or not allow_partial or same_text.state not in {"unconfirmed", "missing_proof"}:
                return None
            from .delivery_scope import coordinates as region_key
            from .delivery_scope import select_scoped_guard, withhold_regions
            controls = snapshot.get("page_controls", ())
            if coordinates & {region_key(p) for p in controls}:
                # Use the SAME page-proof rule as the producer. A weak
                # redundant tab is not a changed page when the remaining
                # independently proved controls still classify that page.
                # This subset belongs only to this delivery, never the store.
                from ..detectors.layout import select_proved_equipment_controls
                # frame_stamp already decoded THIS latest capture off-thread.
                # Reuse its native dimensions, rather than reopen the same
                # image synchronously on the query/follow-up event loop.
                width, height = current_stamp[0]
                admitted_controls = select_proved_equipment_controls(
                    {"page_type": evidence.get("page_type")}, controls,
                    lambda p: region_key(p) not in coordinates, width=width, height=height)
                if not admitted_controls:
                    return None
                snapshot = {**snapshot, "page_controls": admitted_controls}
                trace_refresh(owner, "delivery_page_controls_selected", input_count=len(controls),
                              proved_count=len(admitted_controls))
            pruned = withhold_regions(evidence, coordinates, identity_proofs=snapshot.get("identity_proofs", ()))
            partial = select_scoped_guard(owner, pruned, plan, [guard], proof_source=snapshot, allow_partial=True)
            if partial is None or any(p[0] in coordinates for p in partial[1][1]):
                return None
            evidence, guard = partial
            regions, patches = guard
            current_patches = await asyncio.to_thread(region_stamp, latest.image_bytes, regions)
            if not still_current() or regions_changed(patches, current_patches):
                return _SUPERSEDED if not still_current() else None
            text_changed = False
    if global_changed or text_changed:
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="pixels_changed", global_changed=global_changed, regions_changed=text_changed)
        if owns_current:
            await invalidate_frame_change(owner, snapshot["stamp"], current_stamp,
                                          getattr(owner, "_accepted_frame_page_regions", ()), "visual_snapshot_needs_refresh")
        return None
    from .observation_store import ObservationStore
    if owns_current:
        ObservationStore(owner).clear_deferred({patch[0] for patch in patches})
    from .delivery_scope import coordinates as region_key
    control_coordinates = {region_key(p) for p in snapshot.get("page_controls", ())}
    deferred = getattr(owner, "_deferred_verification", None)
    # The resident watcher may quarantine control PIXELS while this consumer
    # awaits exact-text verification. The checked packet is valid for its own
    # scope; it must not bless all other fields or clear a capture/stop failure.
    control_quarantine_only = (
        getattr(owner, "_observation_pending_reason", "") == "verification_pending_control"
        and bool(control_coordinates) and control_coordinates <= {p[0] for p in patches}
        and not (deferred and deferred[:2] == (epoch, serial) and deferred[2] & control_coordinates)
    )
    if (epoch != getattr(owner, "_observation_epoch", 0) or serial != getattr(owner, "_observation_serial", 0)
            or not owner._observer_status.get("enabled") or getattr(owner, "_observer_stop_requested", False)
            or owner._observer_status.get("state") in {"paused", "stopped"}
            or pending_reason != getattr(owner, "_observation_pending_reason", "") and not control_quarantine_only):
        trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_miss", reason="invalidated_during_check")
        return None
    if recovering:
        # Only this scoped handoff is authorized. Keep pending_reason masking
        # the global full result; its other actors/text were NOT revalidated.
        owner._observer_status.update(state="observing", message="正在核对当前界面信息")
    result = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
    result["read_scope"] = "region" if evidence.get("read_scope") == "region" else "full" if full else "navigation" if navigation else "scene"
    pending_character = bool(result.get("equipment_complete") and not result.get("characters")
                             and not result.get("page_characters"))
    result.update(status="confirmed", failure_reason="character_pending" if pending_character else "",
                  text_coverage_complete=False,
                  message=("已用新采集画面核对遗器词条；当前帧未确认角色归属。" if pending_character else
                           "已用新采集画面核对本结果依赖的文字和控件区域；未重复整轮识别，未确认的字段仍未知。"))
    result["screen_facts"]["unclassified_text"] = []
    try:
        final_age = observation_tick(time.time()) - datetime.fromisoformat(result["observed_at"]).timestamp()
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        final_age = age
    stale = stale_state(result.get("page_type"), final_age, allow_stale=allow_stale) == "stale"
    result["freshness"] = "stale" if stale else "fresh"
    result["age_seconds"] = round(max(0.0, final_age), 1)
    if stale:
        seconds = max(1, int(round(final_age)))
        result["age_label"] = f"这是 {seconds} 秒前的画面，现在可能变了"
        result["message"] = result["age_label"] + "：" + result.get("message", "")
    original_serial = result["screen_facts"].get("observation_serial", 0)
    # This is a delivery revision, not a new OCR/capture timestamp. Pixels for
    # these scoped values passed validation against this stable store revision.
    result["screen_facts"]["observation_serial"] = serial
    from .equipment_view import equipment_card
    result["screen_facts"]["equipment_card"] = equipment_card(result)
    result["reuse"] = {"validated_at": datetime.fromtimestamp(latest.timestamp).astimezone().isoformat(),
                       "original_age_seconds": round(age, 3), "ocr_repeated": False, "epoch": epoch,
                       "original_serial": original_serial, "validated_revision": serial,
                       "answer_generation": generation, "reviewed_fields": sorted(plan.fields) if plan else None,
                       "native_text_reviewed": native_reviewed, "full_recognition_repeated": False,
                       "stale": stale, "age_seconds": result["age_seconds"]}
    result["reuse"].update(reviewed_coordinates=[list(p[0]) for p in patches],
                           page_control_coordinates=[list(c) for c in sorted(control_coordinates)],
                           challenge_revision=getattr(owner, "_review_challenge_serial", 0),
                           capture_failure_revision=getattr(owner, "_capture_failure_revision", 0))
    from ..adapters.text_verification import identity_literal
    from .delivery_boundary import fact_packet_digest, identity_packet_digest
    result["reuse"]["fact_packet_digest"] = fact_packet_digest(result)
    result["reuse"]["identity_packet_digest"] = identity_packet_digest(result)
    result["reuse"]["identity_coordinates"] = [list(region_key(identity_literal(a) or a))
        for a in snapshot.get("identity_proofs") or [] if a.get("region")]

    if owns_current:
        from .fact_lifecycle import record_verified_regions
        record_verified_regions(owner, {p[0] for p in patches}, latest.timestamp, serial=serial)
    result["last_verified_at"] = result["reuse"]["validated_at"]
    result["freshness_basis"] = "scoped_live_verification"
    slots = getattr(owner, "_team_slot_states", None)
    if slots:
        from .observation_store import attach_team_roster
        attach_team_roster(result, slots)
    trace_refresh(owner, "reuse_validated", original_age_seconds=round(age, 3),
                  stale=stale, age_seconds=result["age_seconds"])
    return result

functions._observer_loop:
async def _observer_loop(self) -> None:
    while True:
        try:
            # Prefer the independent loopback assistant.  If the helper is
            # unavailable, the in-process compatibility path must also
            # use isolated window capture. Never fall back to desktop
            # pixels containing the character overlay or chat bubbles.
            with diagnostic_step(self, "assistant_connection") as diagnostic_stage:
                health = await asyncio.to_thread(self._assistant_client.health)
                if not health.get("connected"):
                    await asyncio.to_thread(self._assistant_process.start_if_due)
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
                    health = await asyncio.to_thread(self._assistant_client.health)
                diagnostic_stage["outcome"] = "connected" if health.get("connected") else "unavailable"
            diagnostic_note(self, "first_observation", "started")
            helper_connected = bool(health.get("connected"))
            image_bytes: bytes
            mime: str
            signature: bytes
            public_window: dict[str, Any]
            capture_backend = "assistant"
            assistant_frame = None
            if helper_connected:
                if int(health.get("frame_seq") or 0) < self._assistant_frame_seq:
                    self._assistant_frame_seq = 0
                game = dict(health.get("game") or {})
                capture = dict(health.get("capture") or {})
                public_window = {
                    key: value
                    for key, value in game.items()
                    if key in {"title", "pid", "process_name", "left", "top", "width", "height", "minimized", "foreground"}
                }
                if capture.get("state") == "error":
                    if capture.get("reason") in {"window_capture_no_new_frame", "window_capture_stale_frame"}:
                        record_vision_event(self, "capture_no_fresh_frame", reason=capture["reason"],
                                            frame_seq=int(health.get("frame_seq") or 0))
                    await self._invalidate_current_observation("capture_error")
                    self._set_observer_status(
                        "error",
                        str(capture.get("message") or "视觉助手已连接，但读取游戏画面失败，请重新检查连接。"),
                        window=public_window,
                        assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                        capture_backend=capture_backend,
                    )
                    await self._wait_observer_tick(3)
                    continue
                if not game.get("running"):
                    await self._invalidate_current_observation("game_closed")
                    self._announced_game_pid = 0
                    self._set_observer_status(
                        "waiting",
                        "后台感知已就绪，正在等待《崩坏：星穹铁道》",
                        assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                        capture_backend=capture_backend,
                    )
                    await self._wait_observer_tick(2)
                    continue
                if capture.get("state") == "paused":
                    await self._invalidate_current_observation("capture_paused")
                    reason = str(capture.get("reason") or "")
                    self._set_observer_status(
                        "paused",
                        "星铁已最小化，后台感知已暂停"
                        if reason == "game_minimized"
                        else "当前助手仍要求游戏处于前台，请更新独立视觉助手"
                        if reason == "game_not_foreground"
                        else str(capture.get("message") or "游戏窗口暂时无法采集，恢复显示后会继续观察"),
                        window=public_window,
                        assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                        capture_backend=capture_backend,
                    )
                    await self._wait_observer_tick(2)
                    continue
                if capture.get("state") == "capturing" and capture.get("isolated_window") is not True:
                    await self._invalidate_current_observation("legacy_desktop_capture")
                    self._set_observer_status(
                        "error", "请更新独立视觉助手：旧版本会把猫娘和气泡截进游戏画面，已暂停使用。",
                        window=public_window, assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                        capture_backend="legacy_desktop_rejected",
                    )
                    await self._wait_observer_tick(3)
                    continue
                assistant_frame = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self._assistant_client.fetch_frame,
                    self._assistant_frame_seq,
                )
                if assistant_frame is None:
                    if capture.get("frame_semantics") == "every_capture":
                        seq = health.get("frame_seq")
                        if seq != getattr(self, "_last_missing_frame_seq", None):
                            self._last_missing_frame_seq = seq
                            record_vision_event(self, "capture_waiting_frame", frame_seq=seq)
                        # Modern helpers already own an independent capture
                        # session. No new sequence is a temporary wait, not
                        # permission to start a competing in-process session.
                        self._set_observer_status(
                            "updating" if getattr(self, "_observation_pending_reason", "") else "observing",
                            "正在等待新的游戏画面", window=public_window,
                            assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                            capture_backend=capture_backend,
                        )
                        await self._wait_observer_tick(.25)
                        continue
                    elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._observer_last_push_monotonic
                    pending = bool(self._runtime.pending_scene or self._runtime.pending_character_ids)
                    if (
                        getattr(self, "_visual_query_waiters", 0) > 0 or getattr(self, "_pending_answer", None) is not None
                        or getattr(self, "_observation_invalidated", False)
                        or (pending and elapsed >= 3) or elapsed >= 4
                    ):
                        # Compatibility with released helpers that sequence
                        # only changed pixels: independently capture AGAIN,
                        # never count a cached screenshot as a second frame.
                        window = await asyncio.to_thread(find_hsr_window)
                        if window is None or window.minimized:
                            await self._invalidate_current_observation("capture_unavailable")
                            await self._wait_observer_tick(1.5)
                            continue
                        image_bytes, mime, signature = await asyncio.to_thread(capture_game_window, window)
                        public_window = window.public()
                        capture_backend = "plugin_compatibility"
                    else:
                        self._set_observer_status(
                            "observing", "后台感知运行中，画面没有明显变化",
                            window=public_window, assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                            capture_backend=capture_backend,
                            last_frame_at=self._observer_status.get("last_frame_at", ""),
                            last_delivery=self._observer_status.get("last_delivery", {}),
                        )
                        await self._wait_observer_tick(1.5)
                        continue
                else:
                    self._last_missing_frame_seq = None
                    self._assistant_frame_seq = assistant_frame.frame_seq
                    image_bytes = assistant_frame.image_bytes
                    mime = assistant_frame.mime
                    signature = assistant_frame.signature.encode("ascii", "ignore")
                    public_window = {
                        key: value for key, value in assistant_frame.game.items()
                        if key in {"title", "pid", "process_name", "left", "top", "width", "height", "minimized", "foreground"}
                    }
            else:
                capture_backend = "plugin_compatibility"
                window = await asyncio.to_thread(find_hsr_window)
                if window is None:
                    await self._invalidate_current_observation("game_closed")
                    self._set_observer_status(
                        "waiting",
                        "备用识别正在等待星铁窗口；独立助手尚未连接",
                        assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                        capture_backend=capture_backend,
                    )
                    await self._wait_observer_tick(3)
                    continue
                public_window = window.public()
                if window.minimized:
                    await self._invalidate_current_observation("capture_paused")
                    self._set_observer_status(
                        "paused", "星铁已最小化，自动观察已暂停", window=public_window,
                        capture_backend=capture_backend,
                        assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                    )
                    await self._wait_observer_tick(3)
                    continue
                image_bytes, mime, signature = await asyncio.to_thread(capture_game_window, window)
            if assistant_frame is not None and (getattr(self, "_visual_query_waiters", 0) > 0 or getattr(self, "_pending_answer", None) is not None) and not 0 <= time.time() - assistant_frame.timestamp <= 2:
                if capture.get("frame_semantics") == "every_capture":
                    trace_refresh(self, "capture_rejected", reason="stale_frame")
                    await self._invalidate_current_observation("capture_unavailable_stale_frame")
                    self._set_observer_status("updating", "正在等待新的游戏画面")
                    await self._wait_observer_tick(.25)
                    continue
                # Never spend a query's OCR budget on a known-old helper
                # frame. Recapture this exact game window, not the desktop.
                trace_refresh(self, "capture_rejected", reason="stale_frame")
                window = await asyncio.to_thread(find_hsr_window)
                if window is None or window.minimized or window.public().get("pid") != public_window.get("pid"):
                    await self._invalidate_current_observation("capture_unavailable")
                    await self._wait_observer_tick(.25)
                    continue
                image_bytes, mime, signature = await asyncio.to_thread(capture_game_window, window)
                public_window, assistant_frame, capture_backend = window.public(), None, "plugin_compatibility"
            if getattr(self, "_observer_stop_requested", False):
                return
            self._observer_status["state"] = "observing"
            self._announce_game_presence(public_window)
            now = time.monotonic()
            elapsed = now - self._observer_last_push_monotonic
            difference = frame_difference(self._observer_last_signature, signature)
            self._watch_frame_timestamp = assistant_frame.timestamp if assistant_frame is not None else None
            changed = await watch_latest_frame(self, image_bytes, helper=capture_backend == "assistant")
            should_push = (
                changed or self._observer_last_signature is None
                or getattr(self, "_visual_query_waiters", 0) > 0 or getattr(self, "_pending_answer", None) is not None
                or (elapsed >= 1.5 and bool(self._runtime.pending_scene or self._runtime.pending_character_ids))
                or (elapsed >= 2 and difference >= 0.025)
                or elapsed >= 4
            )
            should_push = await patrol_should_scan(self, image_bytes, requested=should_push, changed=changed,
                frame_seq=getattr(assistant_frame, "frame_seq", None),
                captured_at=getattr(assistant_frame, "timestamp", None), pid=public_window.get("pid"))
            if should_push:
                if getattr(self, "_active_refresh_trace", None) is not None:
                    trace_refresh(self, "capture_selected", backend=capture_backend,
                                  age_seconds=round(time.time() - assistant_frame.timestamp, 3) if assistant_frame is not None else 0)
                capture_started_at = time.monotonic()
                captured_at = (
                    datetime.fromtimestamp(assistant_frame.timestamp, timezone.utc).isoformat()
                    if assistant_frame is not None else utc_now_iso()
                )
                self._analysis_capture_at = captured_at
                self._analysis_input_frame_seq = assistant_frame.frame_seq if assistant_frame is not None else None
                self._analysis_game_pid = public_window.get("pid", 0)
                image_fingerprint = await asyncio.to_thread(visual_fingerprint, image_bytes)
                await self._store_value(
                    "active_game_visual_request",
                    {
                        "fingerprint": image_fingerprint,
                        "created_at": utc_now_iso(),
                        "mime": mime,
                        "source": "auto_window",
                        "image_stored": False,
                    },
                )
                # Released helpers may sequence only changed pixels. The
                # independently recaptured compatibility frame still uses
                # that connected helper to monitor transitions and publish
                # early scene evidence; do not await the whole OCR pass.
                diagnostic_note(self, "first_observation", "completed")
                diagnostic_note(self, "first_commit", "started")
                analysis = await guarded_analysis(self, image_bytes, helper=helper_connected)
                if analysis is None:
                    self._set_observer_status("updating", "正在核对当前界面信息")
                    await asyncio.sleep(.1)
                    continue
                # Focus can move to chat during OCR without invalidating
                # the isolated game surface. Closure/minimization cannot.
                if capture_backend == "assistant":
                    trace_refresh(self, "health_check_started")
                    check = await asyncio.to_thread(self._assistant_client.health)
                    trace_refresh(self, "health_check_finished")
                    still_current = bool(
                        check.get("connected") and (check.get("game") or {}).get("running")
                        and not (check.get("game") or {}).get("minimized")
                        and (check.get("capture") or {}).get("state") == "capturing"
                        and (check.get("capture") or {}).get("isolated_window") is True
                        and (check.get("game") or {}).get("pid") == public_window.get("pid")
                    )
                else:
                    check_window = await asyncio.to_thread(find_hsr_window)
                    still_current = bool(
                        check_window and not check_window.minimized
                        and check_window.public().get("pid") == public_window.get("pid")
                    )
                if not still_current:
                    if job := analysis.get("_relic_job"):
                        record_vision_event(self, "relic_job_ended", **job, outcome="rejected",
                                            reason="capture_changed_during_analysis")
                    await self._invalidate_current_observation("capture_changed_during_analysis")
                    self._set_observer_status("paused", "分析期间游戏窗口不可用或已变化，等待新的游戏画面")
                    await self._wait_observer_tick(1.5)
                    continue
                # Long successful production is a candidate, not a fresh
                # answer. Its storage must not depend on a question's
                # generation or on the age of the verifier's input frame.
                # A current answer still needs its own scoped live receipt.
                if time.monotonic() - capture_started_at > 30:
                    from .runtime.fact_lifecycle import late_read_proved
                    if not late_read_proved(self, analysis):
                        record_late_discard(self)
                        if job := analysis.get("_relic_job"):
                            record_vision_event(self, "relic_job_ended", **job, outcome="rejected",
                                                reason="candidate_too_old")
                        self._set_observer_status("updating", "本轮识别耗时较长，保留已确认结果并继续核对")
                        await self._wait_observer_tick(1.5)
                        continue
                    trace_refresh(self, "late_validated_candidate", answer_receipt_not_implied=True)
                # 0.9 no longer relies on N.E.K.O's video/vision chat to
                # interpret every frame. Only locally verified structured
                # facts are delivered below; the raw frame stays inside
                # the helper/plugin process and is never pushed to chat.
                await self._store_value(
                    "active_game_visual_request",
                    {
                        "fingerprint": image_fingerprint,
                        "created_at": utc_now_iso(),
                        "mime": mime,
                        "source": "auto_window",
                        "image_stored": False,
                        "character_regions": [
                            {
                                "name": str(item.get("name") or ""),
                                "fingerprint": str(item.get("visual_fingerprint") or ""),
                            }
                            for item in analysis.get("characters") or []
                            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("visual_fingerprint")
                        ],
                    },
                )
                trace_refresh(self, "commit_started", job_id=getattr(self, "_vision_job_id", 0),
                              frame_seq=self._analysis_input_frame_seq)
                previous_full = getattr(self, "_last_full_commit_serial", 0)
                local_result = await self._apply_local_analysis(
                    analysis,
                    image_fingerprint=image_fingerprint,
                    observed_at=captured_at,
                    source=(
                        "assistant_local_ocr"
                        if assistant_frame is not None
                        else "plugin_compatibility_local_ocr"
                    ),
                )
                if (local_result.get("delivery") or {}).get("reason") == "analysis_yielded_incomplete":
                    self._set_observer_status("updating", "提问优先，保留上一次完整画面，稍后补读")
                    await asyncio.sleep(.1)
                    continue
                trace_refresh(self, "commit_finished", job_id=getattr(self, "_vision_job_id", 0),
                              frame_seq=self._analysis_input_frame_seq)

                if getattr(self, "_last_full_commit_serial", 0) > previous_full:
                    await patrol_remember_capture(self, image_bytes)
                self._observer_last_signature = signature
                self._observer_last_push_monotonic = time.monotonic()
                scene_key = str((analysis.get("scene") or {}).get("primary_state") or "unknown")
                scene_label = GAME_STATE_LABELS.get(scene_key, GAME_STATE_LABELS["unknown"])
                names = [
                    str(item.get("name") or "")
                    for item in analysis.get("characters") or []
                    if isinstance(item, dict)
                ]
                self._set_observer_status(
                    "observing",
                    f"本地识别：{scene_label}",
                    window=public_window,
                    last_frame_at=utc_now_iso(),
                    scene=scene_key,
                    recognized_characters=names,
                    ocr=dict(analysis.get("ocr") or {}),
                    capture_backend=capture_backend,
                    assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                    runtime=self._runtime.snapshot(),
                    last_delivery={
                        "submitted": bool((local_result.get("delivery") or {}).get("submitted")),
                        "reason": str((local_result.get("delivery") or {}).get("reason") or ""),
                        "ai_behavior": str((local_result.get("delivery") or {}).get("ai_behavior") or ""),
                        "event_kind": str((local_result.get("delivery") or {}).get("event_kind") or ""),
                        "proactive_requested": bool(
                            (local_result.get("delivery") or {}).get("proactive_requested")
                        ),
                    },
                )
            else:
                self._set_observer_status(
                    "observing",
                    "画面没有明显变化，继续观察中",
                    window=public_window,
                    capture_backend=capture_backend,
                    assistant={**self._assistant_process.snapshot(), **health},
                    last_frame_at=self._observer_status.get("last_frame_at", ""),
                    last_delivery=self._observer_status.get("last_delivery", {}),
                )
            await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            diagnostic_note(self, "first_observation", "cancelled")
            diagnostic_note(self, "first_commit", "cancelled")
            raise
        except VisionWorkerBusy as exc:
            self._set_observer_status("updating", str(exc))
            await self._wait_observer_tick(1)
        except RuntimeError as exc:
            diagnostic_note(self, "first_observation", "failed", error=exc)
            diagnostic_note(self, "first_commit", "failed", error=exc)
            await self._invalidate_current_observation("capture_error")
            self._set_observer_status("error", str(exc))
            await self._wait_observer_tick(3)
        except Exception as exc:  # keep the plugin alive if capture fails
            diagnostic_note(self, "first_observation", "failed", error=exc)
            diagnostic_note(self, "first_commit", "failed", error=exc)
            await self._invalidate_current_observation("capture_error")
            self.logger.warning("HSR observer paused: %s", exc, exc_info=True)
            self._set_observer_status("error", "暂时无法读取星铁窗口，插件会自动重试")
            await self._wait_observer_tick(5)
functions._apply_local_analysis:
async def _apply_local_analysis(
    self,
    analysis: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    image_fingerprint: str,
    source: str,
    deliver_event: bool = True,
    observed_at: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Commit only stabilized local observations and deliver one event at most."""

    epoch = getattr(self, "_observation_epoch", 0)
    corrections = await self._read_corrections()
    if epoch != getattr(self, "_observation_epoch", 0) or getattr(self, "_observer_stop_requested", False):
        return {"delivery": {"submitted": False, "reason": "observation_revoked"}}
    recognition = analysis.get("recognition") or {}
    if (recognition.get("yielded_for_query") is True
            or (recognition.get("portrait_templates") or {}).get("reason") == "yielded_for_query"):
        # A query may preempt the producer. The text-only frame is not a
        # complete observation; keep the previous complete evidence and
        # let the producer retry after the query.
        trace_refresh(self, "candidate_retained", reason="yielded_for_query")
        if hasattr(self, "_visual_update_event"):
            self._visual_update_event.set()
        return {"delivery": {"submitted": False, "reason": "analysis_yielded_incomplete"}}
    corrected_characters: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for candidate in list(analysis.get("characters") or []):
        if not isinstance(candidate, dict):
            continue
        record = self._catalog.get(str(candidate.get("entity_id") or ""))
        if not record or record.get("entity_type") != "character" or record.get("name") != candidate.get("name"):
            continue
        observed_key = normalize_observed_name(candidate.get("name"))
        candidate_region_fingerprint = str(candidate.get("visual_fingerprint") or "")
        matched = [
            item
            for item in corrections
            if isinstance(item, dict)
            and item.get("modality") == "vision"
            and item.get("scope") == "visual_fingerprint"
            and normalize_observed_name(item.get("observed_name")) == observed_key
            and candidate_region_fingerprint
            and visual_fingerprints_match(
                item.get("scope_value"),
                candidate_region_fingerprint,
                max_distance=4,
            )
        ]
        if not matched:
            corrected_characters.append(dict(candidate))
            continue
        matched.sort(key=lambda item: str(item.get("updated_at") or ""), reverse=True)
        correction = matched[0]
        record = self._catalog.resolve_character(str(correction.get("canonical_name") or ""))
        if record:
            corrected_characters.append(
                {
                    **dict(candidate),
                    "entity_id": record["id"],
                    "name": record["name"],
                    "evidence": "player_visual_region_correction",
                    "confidence": "high",
                    "correction_id": correction.get("correction_id"),
                }
            )
    analysis = {**analysis, "characters": corrected_characters}
    from .runtime.fact_lifecycle import incomplete_same_page_read
    if source.startswith(("assistant", "plugin_compatibility")) and incomplete_same_page_read(self, analysis):
        # Do not let a weak same-page reread overwrite an independently
        # checkable complete result. Missing text is not new item data;
        # changed values/objects still replace the old commit normally.
        self._runtime.note_identity_read_issue(analysis)
        trace_refresh(self, "candidate_retained", reason="same_page_incomplete_read")
        from .runtime.page_control_trace import record_controls
        record_controls(self, "retained", analysis=analysis)
        if hasattr(self, "_visual_update_event"):
            self._visual_update_event.set()
        return {"delivery": {"submitted": False, "reason": "same_page_incomplete_read"}}
    await self._store_value(
        "active_game_visual_request",
        {
            "fingerprint": image_fingerprint,
            "created_at": utc_now_iso(),
            "source": source,
            "image_stored": False,
            "character_regions": [
                {
                    "name": str(item.get("name") or ""),
                    "fingerprint": str(item.get("visual_fingerprint") or ""),
                }
                for item in corrected_characters
                if item.get("visual_fingerprint")
            ],
        },
    )

    scene = analysis.get("scene") or {}
    if (
        (analysis.get("recognition") or {}).get("scene_only_query")
        and scene.get("verified") and scene.get("confidence") == "high"
        and self._runtime.stable_scene != scene.get("primary_state")
    ):
        # A query-only capture already passed latest-control validation;
        # do not keep the previous scene's two-full-frame waiting gate.
        self._runtime.invalidate_observation(reason="scene_only_transition")
    event, decisions = self._runtime.ingest(
        analysis, proactive_enabled=deliver_event and self._observer_status.get("proactive_enabled") is True,
        idle_chatter_enabled=self._observer_status.get("idle_chatter_enabled") is True,
        track_identity=source.startswith(("assistant", "plugin_compatibility")),
    )
    scene = dict(analysis.get("scene") or {})
    stable_scene = self._runtime.stable_scene
    accepted = bool(stable_scene != "unknown" and stable_scene == scene.get("primary_state"))
    if accepted:
        observation = build_game_state_observation(
            primary_state=stable_scene,
            substate=str(scene.get("substate") or ""),
            confidence=str(scene.get("confidence") or "mixed"),
            evidence=list(scene.get("evidence") or []),
            summary=(
                f"本地页面识别确认："
                f"{(analysis.get('page') or {}).get('label') or GAME_STATE_LABELS.get(stable_scene, stable_scene)}"
            ),
            source=source,
            verification="verified",
            visual_fingerprint=image_fingerprint,
        )
        await self._store_value("current_game_state", observation)
        await self._store_value("pending_game_state_candidate", {})
        history = await self._read_game_state_history()
        history.append(
            {
                **observation,
                "accepted": True,
                "transition_reason": "local_runtime_stabilized",
            }
        )
        await self._store_value("game_state_history", history[-50:])
    else:
        # Do not leave a prior menu/battle in the authoritative current slot.
        await self._store_value("current_game_state", {})
        await self._store_value("pending_game_state_candidate", {})

    self._observation_serial = getattr(self, "_observation_serial", 0) + 1
    public_analysis = {
        "observation_serial": self._observation_serial,
        "ok": bool(analysis.get("ok")),
        "scene": scene,
        "page": dict(analysis.get("page") or {}),
        "characters": list(analysis.get("characters") or []),
        "recognition": dict(analysis.get("recognition") or {}),
        "selection": dict(analysis.get("selection") or {}),
        "screen_facts": dict(analysis.get("screen_facts") or {}),
        "ocr": dict(analysis.get("ocr") or {}),
        "catalog_revision": self._catalog.revision,
        "image_stored": False,
        "visual_fingerprint": image_fingerprint,
        "source": source,
        "observed_at": observed_at or utc_now_iso(),
        "runtime": self._runtime.snapshot(),
        "decisions": decisions,
    }
    previous = getattr(self, "_last_full_characters", None) or {}
    reader = (public_analysis.get("recognition") or {}).get("text_reader") or {}
    character_context = None
    if (reader.get("relic_priority") and not public_analysis["characters"]
            and (public_analysis.get("page") or {}).get("page_type") == "relic_detail"):
        previous_page = previous.get("page")
        candidates = previous.get("characters") or []
        try:
            observed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(previous.get("observed_at") or "").replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            if observed.tzinfo is None:
                observed = observed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            age = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - observed).total_seconds()
        except ValueError:
            age = -1.0
        if (previous_page in {"character_detail", "relic_detail"} and candidates
                and 0 <= age <= VISUAL_TTL_SECONDS):
            actor = candidates[0]
            character_context = {
                "entity_id": actor.get("entity_id"),
                "name": actor.get("name"),
                "identity_scope": actor.get("identity_scope"),
                "source": "previous_full_read",
                "observed_at": previous.get("observed_at"),
                "age_seconds": round(age, 3),
                "confirmed_on_current_frame": False,
                "same_round": True,
            }
    public_analysis["character_context"] = character_context
    await self._store_value("last_local_vision", public_analysis)
    if epoch != getattr(self, "_observation_epoch", 0) or getattr(self, "_observer_stop_requested", False):
        return {"delivery": {"submitted": False, "reason": "observation_revoked"}}
    trace_refresh(self, "observation_committed", serial=public_analysis["observation_serial"])
    ObservationStore(self).commit(public_analysis)
    diagnostic_note(self, "first_commit", "completed")
    record_candidate(self, "candidate_committed", public_analysis,
                     serial=public_analysis["observation_serial"],
                     **({"job_id": getattr(self, "_vision_job_id", 0),
                         "frame_seq": getattr(self, "_analysis_input_frame_seq", None)}
                        if source == "assistant_local_ocr" else {}))
    confirmed = [
        item for item in public_analysis["characters"]
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("entity_id") and item.get("name")
        and item.get("identity_scope") in {"detail_subject", "screen_label"}
        and item.get("confidence") in {"high", "mixed"}
    ]
    if (confirmed and (public_analysis.get("page") or {}).get("page_type")
            in {"character_detail", "relic_detail"}):
        self._last_full_characters = {
            "page": public_analysis["page"]["page_type"],
            "characters": [
                {key: item.get(key) for key in ("entity_id", "name", "identity_scope", "confidence")}
                for item in confirmed[:4]
            ],
            "observed_at": public_analysis["observed_at"],
            "serial": public_analysis["observation_serial"],
        }
    record_relic_stage(self, "relic_committed", public_analysis, analysis.get("_relic_job"),
                       serial=self._observation_serial)
    if public_visual_evidence(public_analysis, {"enabled": True, "state": "observing"})["read_scope"] == "full":
        self._last_full_commit_serial = self._observation_serial
    self._scene_preview = None
    self._observation_invalidated = False
    self._accepted_frame_stamp = getattr(self, "_next_frame_stamp", None)
    self._accepted_frame_page_type = public_analysis["page"].get("page_type", "unknown")
    self._accepted_frame_identity_guarded = getattr(self, "_next_frame_identity_guarded", False)
    self._accepted_frame_characters = [*public_analysis["characters"], *fact_regions(public_analysis)]
    self._accepted_frame_scene_only = getattr(self, "_next_frame_scene_only", False)
    self._accepted_frame_scene_regions = getattr(self, "_next_frame_scene_regions", ())
    self._accepted_frame_page_regions = getattr(self, "_next_frame_page_regions", ())
    from .runtime.page_control_trace import record_controls
    record_controls(self, "committed", analysis=public_analysis, controls=self._accepted_frame_page_regions)
    self._accepted_frame_delivery_guard = getattr(self, "_next_frame_delivery_guard", None)
    self._accepted_frame_query_guard = getattr(self, "_next_frame_query_guard", None)
    self._accepted_frame_full_query_guard = getattr(self, "_next_frame_full_query_guard", None)
    validation = analysis.get("_live_validation") or {}
    self._producer_validation = ({**validation, "serial": self._observation_serial,
        "challenge_revision": getattr(self, "_review_challenge_serial", 0),
        "capture_failure_revision": getattr(self, "_capture_failure_revision", 0)} if validation else None)
    if validation:
        from .runtime.fact_lifecycle import record_verified_regions
        guard = self._accepted_frame_delivery_guard
        if guard:
            record_verified_regions(self, {p[0] for p in guard[1]}, validation.get("checked_frame_at"))
    if (validation.get("epoch") == epoch
            and validation.get("query_generation") == getattr(self, "_query_refresh_generation", 0)):
        self._query_validated_read = (validation["query_generation"], epoch, self._observation_serial)
        trace_refresh(self, "completed_read_revalidated", serial=self._observation_serial)
    from .runtime.query_reuse import remember_reusable
    remember_reusable(self, public_analysis)
    if hasattr(self, "_visual_update_event"):
        self._visual_update_event.set()
    self._push_current_visual_context(await self._current_visual_evidence())

    delivery: dict[str, Any] = {"submitted": False, "reason": "no_stable_event"}
    query_busy = (getattr(self, "_visual_query_waiters", 0) > 0 or getattr(self, "_pending_answer", None) is not None
                  or time.monotonic() - getattr(self, "_last_visual_query_at", -1e9) < 15)
    if event is not None and deliver_event and not query_busy:
        plan = build_event_delivery(
            event,
            catalog_revision=self._catalog.revision,
            proactive_enabled=self._observer_status.get("proactive_enabled") is True,
        )
        if plan.ai_behavior == "respond":
            delivery = self._queue_automatic_speech(event, plan, await self._current_visual_evidence())
        else:
            # A passive event adds no new facts beyond the context already
            # committed above. Do not fetch a second frame just to repeat it.
            delivery = {"submitted": False, "reason": "passive_context_already_synced"}
        delivery["ai_behavior"] = plan.ai_behavior
        delivery["event_kind"] = event.kind
        delivery["proactive_requested"] = bool(plan.metadata.get("proactive_requested"))
    return {**public_analysis, "delivery": delivery}
